title: Intel agency recruitment and blackballing interrogation
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Intel agency recruitment and blackballing interrogation, about unspecified at Headquarters of an unnamed US intelligence agency, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Headquarters of an unnamed US intelligence agency

tellings.quote: then I was invited to the headquarters of this agency and went through a very bruising um kind of interrogation

plain: Dr. John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that life on Mars was destroyed by nuclear war, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he was once invited to the headquarters of an unnamed US intelligence agency. He says he went through a very bruising kind of interrogation there, tied to being recruited and then shut out. If true, it would suggest intelligence agencies take a close and unfriendly interest in people who work on these subjects.
